products.title: Mango Avakaya Pickle
products.description: ✨ Top Highlights A legendary Andhra delicacy made from hand-cut raw mangoes, stone-ground mustard, fiery red chillies, and slow-blended in cold-pressed oil. Bold, spicy, tangy, and deeply aromatic — Avakaya in its most authentic, heritage-rich form. 🌶️ Key Highlights ✔ Rich in natural antioxidants & digestive spices ✔ Iconic spicy-tangy flavour of Andhra cuisine ✔ Made with cold-pressed oil for superior taste & preservation ✔ 100% traditional recipe — intense, aromatic, and addictive ✔ Pairs perfectly with rice, ghee, curd rice, rotis & dosas 🫙 Storage Instructions Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight Always use a clean, dry spoon Refrigerate after opening for longer freshness ⏳ Shelf Life Best before: 3 months from date of packing (Refrigeration recommended after opening) 🌟 What Makes SAKYA Farms’ Avakaya Special? Our Avakaya is prepared using hand-selected sour mangoes harvested at peak maturity, blended with freshly ground mustard and premium red chillies. Slow-mixed in cold-pressed sesame oil and naturally matured, this pickle follows age-old Andhra methods — no shortcuts, no artificial additives, only patience and purity. Every batch is crafted to deliver the perfect balance of heat, tang, and aroma — just like homemade.
products.descriptionHtml:
✨ Top Highlights

A legendary Andhra delicacy made from hand-cut raw mangoes, stone-ground mustard, fiery red chillies, and slow-blended in cold-pressed oil. Bold, spicy, tangy, and deeply aromatic — Avakaya in its most authentic, heritage-rich form.

🌶️ Key Highlights

✔ Rich in natural antioxidants & digestive spices
✔ Iconic spicy-tangy flavour of Andhra cuisine
✔ Made with cold-pressed oil for superior taste & preservation
✔ 100% traditional recipe — intense, aromatic, and addictive
✔ Pairs perfectly with rice, ghee, curd rice, rotis & dosas

🫙 Storage Instructions

Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
Always use a clean, dry spoon
Refrigerate after opening for longer freshness

⏳ Shelf Life

Best before: 3 months from date of packing
(Refrigeration recommended after opening)

🌟 What Makes SAKYA Farms’ Avakaya Special?

Our Avakaya is prepared using hand-selected sour mangoes harvested at peak maturity, blended with freshly ground mustard and premium red chillies. Slow-mixed in cold-pressed sesame oil and naturally matured, this pickle follows age-old Andhra methods — no shortcuts, no artificial additives, only patience and purity.

Every batch is crafted to deliver the perfect balance of heat, tang, and aroma — just like homemade.

What is Mustard? Mustard seeds come from the mustard plant — a hardy crop known for its pungent aroma and strong health profile. When cold-pressed, these tiny seeds yield mustard oil, valued for its robust flavour, high heat resistance, and beneficial fatty acids that support overall wellness. What Distinguishes SAKYA Farms’ Mustard Oil? We source mustard seeds from the northern regions of India, known for their climate and soil ideal for mustard cultivation. The seeds are cold-pressed without heat or chemicals, preserving natural nutrients, antioxidants and flavour. This results in an oil that is pure, aromatic, nutritionally richer and far superior to refined alternatives — crafted for traditional cooking, wellness and daily nourishment. What is the shelf life? products.title: A2 Cow Ghee
products.description: Favourite A2 Ghee from desi cow milk using bilona method. Boosts focus, reduces inflammation, and nourishes your body with purity and comfort. What is the True Essence of “Cultured”? Cultured ghee is made by fermenting milk into curd, churning it to butter, and gently clarifying it for richer flavour and superior digestibility. What Distinguishes SAKYA Farms’ Cultured Ghee? Our ghee begins with contented, free-grazing indigenous cows nourished on natural pasture and milked only after the calf is fed — honouring life, purity and balance. Made traditionally in iron kadhais over firewood and sun-dried cow-dung cake, it is slow-crafted from naturally cultured curd, hand-churned to fresh white butter and gently clarified to perfection. Not mere ghee — but heritage, integrity and nourishment in its purest form.
